title: Continuation

launchpad.outcome: Confirm continuation only when price closes back through the PIL in the original direction.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Has price closed back in the original direction yet?

slides.heading: Continuation = the close back in the original direction

beats.title: Bullish
beats.line: Close above → close below → close back ABOVE.

beats.title: Bearish
beats.line: Close below → close above → close back BELOW.

slides.punch: While price stays on the wrong side: CONTINUATION NOT CONFIRMED.

slides.headline: Indication ✓ Correction ✓ … now?
slides.line: Try pressing Confirm Continuation early. See what happens.

slides.quote: You know what you’re waiting for. That doesn’t mean price has done it yet.

slides.prompt: Why do we wait for the continuation close instead of anticipating it?
slides.modelAnswer: Because until a candle closes back through the PIL in the original direction, the sequence isn’t complete. Anticipating it is guessing.

takeaways: Continuation = close back in the original direction.
remember: Continuation tells me price is trying again.
